title: India Nuclear Energy Capacity to triple to 22,380 MW by 2031-32
summary: Dr. Jitendra Singh: Installed nuclear capacity rose from 4,780 MW (2014) to 8,780 MW; targets 22,380 MW by 2032, 47 GW by 2037, 100 GW by 2047.
